{{Quote|My client is in a situation. Hired guns, looking to put him out of business the old fashioned way. Losing my client would destroy this community. I've stepped up to keep that from happening-think you could do the same?|Neb Munb|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Neb Munb''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A professional [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], he was hired by a client to protect them from a group of assassins, and Neb enlisted the help of a Republic-allied individual to complete the job.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], Neb Munb lived in the city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He worked as a professional mercenary, and he was hired as protection for a [[Neb Munb's client|client]] who represented a [[Unidentified vaporator corporation|corporation]] selling vaporators at a discount.<ref name="TOR" />

The client's company had been selling vaporators a low price, which angered the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]]. The criminals had hired a professional killer to take out the client, who sent teams of killers anytime the client used a holoterminal. Upon realizing how the killer was tracking them, Neb hid the client in the Anchorhead cantina, until a Republic-allied individual came across them.<ref name="TOR" />

When they learned about Neb's predicament, Neb asked an individual to use the client's ident card a few times. This will draw out the ambushers, allowing the individual to track them back to their hideout and eliminate the pro. They agreed, and tracked the killer back to a [[Anchorhead Western Warehouse|warehouse]] on the outskirts of Anchorhead. Thanks to the individual's efforts, the client was able to return to his job safely and continue selling good quality vaporators to the settlers for a low price.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neb Munb was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Anchorhead cantina, where he gives Republic players the mission "The Hunted".<ref name="TOR" />
